entries.name: Daigo Haneda
entries.title: Warden Lieutenant
entries.bio: Runs the Wardens' harbor outpost out of a closed ferry terminal. He was the only Warden on duty when the eclipse hit and has not slept since. He takes the player on as a probationary Wick mostly so he can keep an eye on their shadow.
entries.personality: Gruff, tired, quietly kind. Counts everything twice.

entries.name: Yuzuki Tono
entries.title: Warden Prodigy
entries.bio: The youngest Warden in a century. She is sure the player's moving shadow means they are carrying the Gloam, and appoints herself their watcher. Their rivalry turns into the first real alliance of the story.
entries.personality: Precise, competitive, terrible at admitting she was wrong.

entries.name: Kiku Amane
entries.title: Ramen Stall Owner
entries.bio: Runs a late-night ramen stall beside the ferry terminal. She folds her receipts into tiny paper cranes that keep watch on the street, a habit left over from a career she will not talk about.
